messages:
oliver_cs: Reminder 6 onboarding run for AuroraTech Dedicated pool tomorrow 10:00am PT. Scope: quota acceptance, autoscale validation, brief spike test and cost baseline capture. Please RTTA if you can't make it.

mina_eng: I'll join. What are the target profiles and the canary window? Any special model constraints?

oliver_cs: Target: ~25 RPS chat mix, ~1500 tokens/sec (chat model: redwood-chatx-16k:q8). Canary: 15m at 5 RPS, quick spike 40 RPS for 60s, then 20m steady 25 RPS. Model pinned to redwood-chatx-16k:q8:v3.

ricardo_ops: Autoscale policy we'll use: quota-policy-07: min=1, max=10, scale_up_cpu>75% OR queued_requests>50, cool_down=60s. We'll enable ephemeral burst +2 for the spike. Ops will have capacity-on-call.

tara_sre: I'll add SLO monitors: p95 latency alert >200ms, p99 >400ms; error rate >1% triggers rollback. Also adding KV cache eviction watch. If p99 breaches twice in 10m, we abort and route to hosted-fallback.

mina_eng: Load generator: local-k6 script from perf-runner. Ramp pattern: ramp-up 3m -> hold -> spike -> cool-down. Command: 

```
k6 run --vus 30 --duration 30m aurora_k6_script.js --out csv=aurora_k6
```

Script includes a priming step to warm KV with top 100 customer prompts.

ricardo_ops: Ops note: run priming 20m prior to canary. Use low-rate priming to avoid autoscale noise: 2 RPS for 10m across top prompts.

june_cust: I'll be on the call. Renewal team flagged that any bill >10% above forecast needs immediate notice. Also please record cost delta and token distribution per route.

oliver_cs: Action list: 1) mina 6 perf team: provide k6 script + priming payload. 2) ricardo: configure quota-policy-07 and set burst. 3) tara: SLO dashboards + rollback automation. 4) june: collect cost/usage expectations and top 10 prompts. Final sync at 9:45am PT in #customer-success.

deploy-bot: Job scheduled: aurora-dedicated-canary-1723456789 at 2024-07-12T17:00:00Z. Owner: mina_eng.

mina_eng: I'll post a short post-run summary and attach the CSV. If we see latency tail regressions, I'll test q8-latency-tweak flags and spin a v3b variant.

ricardo_ops: Ops will be watching for sustained GPU utilization >85% for 3m; manual bump available at +2 nodes. Otherwise autoscale handles it.

june_cust: We'll fill the feedback form after the run. Thanks everyone.

tara_sre: I'll be monitoring traces and will create an incident channel if we hit rollback. Also adding a postmortem template link into the runbook.

mina_eng: Quick priming snippet: 

```
POST /v1/cache/prime
{"model":"redwood-chatx-16k:q8:v3","prompts":["<promptA>","<promptB>"]}
```

oliver_cs: Thanks team 6 good luck. See you at 9:45. :rocket:
